The signatures

Two things built this cafe's name: sausages made in-house, and hash browns made from scratch, every day. These are the plates regulars cross town for.

An old cottage with a big backyard heart

Snag & Brown lives in a weatherboard cottage on Ekibin Road — retro prints on the walls, a rumpus room with scatter cushions and a bookshelf, and a shady garden out back under the shade sails. It eats local, too: sausages and bacon from Annerley Meats, produce sourced nearby, and Bear Bones coffee in the machine.

Bring the dog. Seriously.

Most cafes tolerate dogs. Snag & Brown built them a park. The fenced back garden doubles as an off-leash pooch park, and the kitchen sends out puppuccinos while you eat.

OFF-LEASH GARDEN

Room to roam

A real backyard, not a footpath table — your dog can stretch out on the grass while breakfast lands.

KIDS WELCOME

Families fit right in

A kids' menu with free froggaccinos, space for prams in the garden, and a retro rumpus room inside for rainy days.
